title: OpenTelemetry Collector
description: NexusFlow otel-collector health (contrib 0.128 → SigNoz). Uses metric names as stored in SigNoz (often *_total). service.name = nexusflow.otel-collector.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv(s.unix_milli, 1000)), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, avg(s.value) AS value FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 AS s INNER JOIN signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 AS t ON s.fingerprint = t.fingerprint AND s.metric_name = t.metric_name WHERE s.metric_name = 'otelcol_process_memory_rss_bytes' AND JSONExtractString(t.labels, 'service.name') = 'nexusflow.otel-collector' AND s.unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp}} * 1000 AND s.unix_milli <= {{.end_timestamp}} * 1000 GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts
